effectiveModel: Uniform deterministic bit algorithm with worst-case running time.

sourceBasis.step: Lin’s Set Cover reduction has a universe of size O(h³ log n) and a budget depending only on h for an n-vertex Multicolored Clique instance with h colors. Froese’s binary address forces one column per address bit, and the two rows at each address must be separated by a selected set containing the corresponding element. The extra budget is the ceiling of the logarithm of the universe size, so 2^k ≤ g(h)(1+log n) for a computable g. Reject a universe element with no incident set before building the matrix. A computable cutoff for an exponent in o_eff(2^k) gives a fixed-parameter algorithm for Multicolored Clique. For each fixed γ < 1, the exponent O(2^(γ k)) admits such a cutoff.
